$comment: Entry schema for contributes.terminalColorSchemes (declarative and process plugins, manifest apiVersion 2). An entry is inline or a {"path"} reference to a JSON file under terminal-schemes/, themes/ or assets/. Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_terminal_color_schemes.go: colors must contain exactly the {{lists.requiredColors}} keys plus optional {{lists.optionalColors}}; values are #rrggbb, and #rrggbbaa is allowed only for {{lists.alphaColors}}. Contrast floors (translucent selections composited on background): foreground/background >= 4.5, cursor/background >= 3.0, (selectionForeground or foreground) on selectionBackground >= 3.0, the 12 chromatic ANSI colours (normal and bright red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan) >= 2.0 on background, and brightBlack >= 1.5 for dark schemes. A scheme that fails is skipped (install is refused).
description: Terminal colour schemes: xterm palettes offered in Settings > Terminal > Colour scheme, independent of the UI theme.

id.description: <pluginId>.<name>; the stored setting names this id.
